header.title: 💰 My balances
chart.title: Evolution
chart.empty: Record some balances to see their evolution here.
accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add one with "+ Account", or import a CSV.
column.name: Account
update.title: Update balances
update.hint: Fill in the balance of each account on that date. Leave one empty to skip it.
account.archived: Archived (closed account: record a 0 balance first)
account.loan_hint: For loans and credit cards, record the debt as a negative balance.
account.confirm_delete: Delete the account "{name}" and all its balances?
csv.title: Import CSV
csv.hint: One row per account and date. Columns: account, date, amount (required); type, currency, institution, note, available_from (optional). Spanish names also work: cuenta, fecha, saldo... An account is found by its name and institution. Missing accounts are created; a balance already recorded on that date is not changed (the row is skipped and listed).
json.title: Import JSON
json.hint: A file from "Export everything (JSON)": accounts with all their details, balances and milestones.
json.merge: Merge: add only what is not there yet (what already exists is not imported, and is listed)
json.replace: Replace: delete all the current data and leave exactly the file's (a backup is made first)
json.confirm_replace: All your current accounts, balances and milestones will be deleted and replaced by the file's. A backup is made first. Continue?
json.result: Accounts created: {accounts}. Balances added: {balances}. Milestones added: {milestones}.
settings.title: Settings
totp.setup_help: Add this account to your authenticator app: scan the QR code, or type the code below. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
settings.time_zone_browser: Dates in the browser's time zone ({zone}). Change it in the settings.
settings.time_zone_chosen: Dates in the time zone chosen in the settings ({zone}).
account.available_hint: Leave it empty if the balance can be used now. For balances you cannot use until a date, e.g. unvested stock options.
totals.with_locked: Including what is not available yet ({locked})
chart.with_locked: Including what is not available yet
demo.title: Demo mode
demo.hint: Shows the app with made-up sample data, to show it to other people or to see how it works. Your real data stays hidden and is not changed.
demo.banner: Demo mode: made-up sample data. Your real data is not shown or changed.
chart.converted_note: {currencies} converted into {currency} at today's ECB rate, on every date.
chart.converted_missing: No exchange rate for {currencies}: left out.
chart.converted_stale: Today's rate could not be updated: the last stored one is used.
milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.hint: Notable expenses (a car, a trip…). They show on the charts as a dotted vertical line on their date.
register.help: You have been invited. Choose a user name and a password: your data is encrypted with it.
register.password_help: At least 10 characters. If you forget it, only the recovery key shown next can open your data.
register.logged_in: You are already logged in in this browser as
register.logged_in_note: Creating this account will log that user out here.
register.error.invitation: This invitation link is not valid: it has been used, has expired or was cancelled. Ask for a new one.
register.error.username: The user name must have 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, and start with a letter or digit.
register.error.email: That email does not look right.
register.error.password: The password must have at least 10 characters.
register.error.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
register.error.taken: That user name or email is already in use.
recovery.help: Save this recovery key somewhere safe (a password manager, or on paper). It is shown only now. If you forget your password, only this key can open your data: nobody else can, not even the admin.
recover.help: Forgot your password? Choose a new one with the recovery key you saved when you created the account.
recover.error: Wrong user name or recovery key.
account.password_help: Your other devices are logged out. Your recovery key does not change.
admin.title: Administration
admin.invite_email: Email (optional: only this email can use the link)
admin.new_link: Invitation link. Copy it now: it is shown only once and works once, for 7 days.
admin.confirm_delete: Delete this user and all their data? This can't be undone.
admin.confirm_delete_block: Delete this user and all their data, and block their email so it can't sign up again? This can't be undone.
admin.no_users: No users yet: create an invitation link below.
admin.blocked_help: These emails can't create an account, even with an invitation.
register.error.full: There is no room for more users right now. Ask the person who invited you.
account.expires_soon: Your account expires in {n} days, and then its data is deleted. Export it now (Import / export → Export everything (JSON)) if you want to keep it, or ask the admin to extend it.
backups.title: Daily backups
backups.hint: One copy a day, made by the server in its data folder (backups/). The last {keep} days are kept.
backups.error: The list of backups could not be loaded.
account.totp_off: Off. To ask for a code from your authenticator app at each login: add this account to the app (scan the QR code, or type the code below), then enter the 6-digit code it shows and your password.
account.totp_on: On: each login asks for a code from your authenticator app. If you lose it, log in with your recovery key (Forgot your password?) or ask the admin to remove it.
admin.confirm_remove_totp: Remove this user's one-time code? They will log in with only the password until they turn it on again.
